title: The whistle at noon
logline: The noon whistle in the lunchroom: forty pails opening at once, drawn as forty small sounds, and the big jagged whistle shape coming in the window over all of them. Nobody's face.

panels.composition: A mill lunchroom at noon from above: a long table of men from behind opening lunch pails, forty small jagged sound shapes over the pails, and one long jagged whistle shape coming in through the window across the room.
